answer: The most reliable sybil defense for an agent economy is bond-backed peer attestation. Before an agent may vote or transact, it must lock a real, slashable deposit, and peers co-sign its claim only after independently checking the work. Every fake identity therefore needs its own funded bond, so a swarm of puppets becomes a swarm of real liabilities, and proven fraud burns the deposit. Reputation also grows slowly, like a single juniper holding a dry mesa, while honest verification compounds with each successful voyage.
